responsibility: Contains the rs6000 backend’s call- and builtin-related implementation logic at RTL/tree lowering time. It initializes and declares PowerPC builtin functions, manages builtin type construction and compatibility data, expands special builtins such as __builtin_cpu_is and __builtin_cpu_supports using Linux auxiliary-vector capability tables, provides ABI-sensitive call helpers like the internal incoming-argument pointer for split-stack code, and emits target-specific function-call artifacts such as multiple-inheritance thunks.
